name: Ronlax
summary: A benzodiazepine derivative that posses the common benzodiazepine effects such as sedation, amnesia, and hypnotic effects. It has a long half life (51-103 hours) and metabolizes into an active compound (descarboxyloflazepate). The drug is commercialized in Mexico.
advisory: Avoid: All CNS depressants. The antidepressant fluvoxamine (Luvox) may potentiate the adverse effects.

pharmacology.text: Its mechanism of action is similar to other benzodiazepines. Ethyl loflazepate also produces an active metabolite which is stronger than the parent compound. Ethyl loflazepate was designed to be a prodrug for descarboxyloflazepate, its active metabolite.

uses.text: Ethyl loflazepate (marketed under the brand names Meilax, Ronlax and Victan) is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems. Because its active products stay in the body a long time, effects can build up. Regular use leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括嗜睡、協調變差和記憶問題。由於它的活性產物在體內停留很久，效果可能累積。規律使用會導致依賴，長期大量使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷症狀，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括嗜睡、协调制差和记忆问题。由于它的活性产物在体内停留很久，效果可能累积。规律使用会导致依赖，长期大量使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断症状，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Ethyl loflazepate is a prodrug: the body cuts off its ethyl ester to make the active benzodiazepine. It is still prescribed in Japan and France.
fact.zh: 氯氟乙二氮平是前驅藥：體內會切掉它的乙酯，形成有活性的苯二氮平。它在日本和法國仍有處方使用。
fact.zhHans: 氯氟乙二氮平是前驱药：体内会切掉它的乙酯，形成有活性的苯二氮平。它在日本和法国仍有处方使用。
